data.text: Answered by the guided init in 0.9: ADRs in docs/adr, docs/decisions or adr are offered as decisions with a preview (KAD-89), and without ADRs one decision by hand; the prompt hook names it from a journal one day old (KAD-88). Decision on seeding: from ADR folders only, with a preview, nothing guessed — CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and PR descriptions left out (DEC-57; the reasons in the onboarding discovery).
